results.summary: Deterministic record-history checker implemented in scripts/check-record-history.py with comprehensive unittest suite in tests/history/. Compares unique IDs, payload hashes, and per-key/partition ordering across topics and partitions without cross-topic count or offset assumptions. Implements distinct duplicate and visibility rules for acks modes (0, 1, -1/all), idempotence, transactional isolation (read_committed vs read_uncommitted), control marker suppression, atomicity, output/offset consistency, and KIP-932 share group delivery (accept/release/reject lifecycle). Deliberately invalid histories produce minimal explanatory counterexamples. Empty histories fail closed with exit code 2.

limits: Test infrastructure and offline verification tool only; does not run live Kafka cluster or modify client source code.
Python standard library only (no external dependencies).
